snippet.title: Season of Belonging Trailer | Sky: Children of the Light
snippet.description:
Just in time for the upcoming holiday season, comes a brand new season as well as breathtaking new areas in the kingdom of Sky! 

Play the latest social adventure experience, Sky, from the award-winning creators of Journey (2013 Game of The Year) and the highly-acclaimed Flower.

Sky is available on the iOS App Store: http://bit.ly/PlaySkyiOS
Fans can now pre-register for Android on Google Play: http://bit.ly/PreregisterSky

Visit our website thatskygame.com, and stay tuned for more news via our social media:
https://twitter.com/thatskygame
https://www.facebook.com/thatskygame
https://www.instagram.com/thatskygame
  
Join the conversation with #thatskygame
